bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
cd "$root"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3e0c06d81257fbbe8a35f024a5916f3b96f1e95e
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
name=libral-vault-libral-vault-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$name")" = healthy
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project" }}' "$name")" = libral-vault
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/data/libral-vault"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")" = /home/admin1/var/lib/libral-vault
docker exec "$name" node -e 'const a=process.env.LIBRAL_VAULT_HTTP_ALLOWLIST.split(",");if(a.includes("https://openrouter.ai"))process.exit(2);if(a.length<2)process.exit(3);console.log("VAULT_EXISTING_PROVIDER_ORIGINS="+a.join(","))'
p="$root/.worktrees/ai-core-openrouter-consumer-20261128"
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/ai-core-openrouter-consumer-20261128
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 22fc6d11f40f8f684430dfe1fd4f03cac0f301b0
if [ ! -d "$p" ]; then git worktree add --detach "$p" 22fc6d11f40f8f684430dfe1fd4f03cac0f301b0; fi
cd "$p"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 22fc6d11f40f8f684430dfe1fd4f03cac0f301b0
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
docker build --pull=false --target runtime -t libral-vault:ai-core-openrouter-22fc6d11 .
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node libral-vault:ai-core-openrouter-22fc6d11 -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("dist/src/server.js","utf8");if(!s.includes("LIBRAL_VAULT_AI_CORE_TOKEN_FILE")||!s.includes("AI_CORE_PROVIDER_SCOPE_DENIED"))process.exit(2);console.log("VAULT_AI_CORE_CANDIDATE_SOURCE=PASS")'
printf 'VAULT_CANDIDATE_BUILD=PASS PRODUCTION_UNCHANGED=YES\n'
